subject.title: fix(hooks): bound hook workspace manifest and HOOK.md reads

question: Should workspace hook package.json and HOOK.md files larger than 1 MiB become unsupported and be skipped with a warning?
rationale: The safety improvement is technically sound, but the chosen limit intentionally changes behavior for any existing oversized workspace metadata and therefore needs maintainer acceptance as the supported compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept the 1 MiB boundary
options.body: Approve warn-and-skip as the supported safety contract, refresh the branch against current main, and land the patch.

options.title: Select a different limit
options.body: Choose a larger or surface-specific cap and update the constants, warning assertions, boundary tests, and real proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Accept the 1 MiB boundary
recommendation.body: Approve warn-and-skip as the supported safety contract, refresh the branch against current main, and land the patch.
